notes.subject: גם ... גם
notes.rationale: Go boela ga lentšu la גם ga bobedi go bopa tekano: Babilona e thushitše, Babilona e wa — papiso ye e lašwa ka ntle kgauswi.

notes.subject: לנפל
notes.rationale: Bao ba sa tsejago: 'go wa ga Babilona' (ylt) kgahlanong le 'go baka go wa ga bao ba hlabetšwego ba Yisraele' (kjv/jps); ke lentšu le tee fela, tlhaloso ya bobedi e laleditšwe ke חללי yeo e latelago.

notes.subject: חללי
notes.rationale: חלל e boela gate-5 mmamogaling wo — bao ba hlabetšwego ba Yisraele le bao ba lefase ka moka — khomareledišano yeo e nabilego go fihla 51:52.

translation: Gomme bjalo ka ge Babilona e dirile gore ba hlabetšwego ba Yisraele ba wa, gape ka Babilona ba waile bao ba hlabetšwego ba lefase ka moka.
